parsed.summary: The patch addresses the input validation issue by allowing non-numeric types, but it may introduce unintended behavior or compatibility issues.

issues.description: The change allows non-numeric types for clustering labels, which may break existing code that assumes numeric labels. This could lead to compatibility issues with other parts of the library or user code.
